findings.detail: bvn: handler enforces length 10, spec requires exactly 11 characters (minLength 11, maxLength 11)
findings.evidence: Line `if len(req.BVN) != 10 {` rejects any bvn whose length is not 10, so an 11-character bvn — which the spec declares valid via minLength 11 / maxLength 11 — is rejected with 400. The spec and the handler bound directly contradict each other (the error text 'bvn must be 11 digits' does not match the enforced bound either). (verified: value for "bvn" satisfies the documented constraint, but the handler returned 400: {"success":false,"code":"invalid_bvn","message":"bvn must be 11 digits"})
